decisions.reason: The Big Block rules from this message are already fully represented by its existing same-message MODIFY Event.
Its existing same-message Event already records issuance of one distinct Small Block and Big Block ticket, their cycles, and the exclusion of secondary-sale ticket generation.
Its existing same-message Event already records the independent counters and the required reset after each corresponding draw.
The client explicitly says the no-referral random ticket allocation remains unchanged.
Its existing same-message Event already captures visibility of the two counters and permanent badges, with no prior candidate key requiring removal.
The source confirms that secondary royalties continue; it does not change whether secondary-sale royalties are enabled.
The client explicitly preserves manual prize claiming as an unchanged mechanic.
The client explicitly preserves the automatic $5 referral commission unchanged.
The source changes ticket eligibility and reset rules owned by the block-prize mechanisms but leaves random ticket-weighted winner selection unchanged.
The prize-mechanics adjustment has no semantic effect on the project's current or planned branding.
